[[Ring of Judgement]] }} == Objectives == Deliver the Bloodstone Pendant to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Undercity. * [[Broken Bloodstone Pendant]] ==Description== ==Rewards== You may choose one of: * [[Lady Winter's Touch]] * [[Ring of Judgement]] You will also receive: * 1200 [[XP]] ==Progress== Speak quickly. I don’t intend to waste my time with vermin. ==Completion== Look what the cat dragged in. I was assuming Wordeen had atleast a smidgeon of competency left in his body, but I was sorely mistaken, it seems. To think one of my artifacts escaped those irritating mages and ended up in the clutches of the Shadow Council. Curious, indeed… , with the return of the pendant, I am closing the book on this unfortunate circumstance among my subordinates. The traitors have been dealt with, my relics are secured and you… You shall be rewarded for delivering a decisive strike against those misusing my possessions. ==Patch changes== {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}
